Chapter 69: Lacking an Unforgettable Love

At 1:30 PM, the bell signaling the end of the lunch break rang.

Ying Chanxi woke up groggily from her desk, tapped Qiao Xinyan beside her, and the two went to the restroom arm in arm.

It's hard to say what it is about going to the restroom, but for girls, the "restroom instance" is generally not something one can take on alone; you must bring a teammate along.

Even Ying Chanxi was no exception.

But as they were leaving the classroom, Qiao Xinyan, with her sharp eyes, spotted Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng coming down from upstairs by the distant staircase.

"Xixi, look over there." Qiao Xinyan shook Ying Chanxi's arm and pointed to the stairwell. "I've noticed that Li Luo is often with Yan Zhusheng."

Ying Chanxi followed her finger and frowned, but her expression quickly relaxed. It was unclear if she was refuting Qiao Xinyan or reassuring herself:

"You're overthinking it. One is the class monitor, and the other is the sports representative. A teacher must have needed them for something."

"That makes sense. Otherwise, why would they be going upstairs in the middle of the day?" Qiao Xinyan nodded in agreement but still added, "But don't you think your cousin and Yan Zhusheng make a good match?"

"Remember during the military training, the two of them even performed a song together on the sports field."

"Li Luo plays the guitar well, and Yan Zhusheng is a good singer. They seem like a match made in heaven."

This was typical of girls in private; they liked to ship CPs when they were bored. Even the top students of Class One were no exception.

"What's so good about him?" Ying Chanxi wrinkled her nose and glanced at Qiao Xinyan. "Yan Zhusheng would never fall for him."

Chatting like this, the two walked into the restroom arm in arm.

Meanwhile, Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng returned to the classroom.

"Why do I always feel like you're looking at me strangely?" Li Luo asked Yan Zhusheng with a puzzled look as he sat down.

"You just rejected my confession. I kind of hate you now," Yan Zhusheng said truthfully.

"Hey, hold on... you..." Li Luo looked at her, speechless. "Aren't you getting a little too into character?"

"It's the only way to sing a sad love song," Yan Zhusheng said seriously. "Otherwise, I can't get into that state of mind."

"Then how did you sing them before?"

"I used to read novels." Yan Zhusheng tilted her head in thought. "Too Late to Say I Love You, Fatal Encounter, Fleet of Time."

"...They're not all angsty stories, are they?"

"I think so." Yan Zhusheng nodded. "But sometimes I can't quite grasp that feeling. Trying it out just now was more effective."

"This is actually due to a lack of life experience." Li Luo leaned back in his chair and chuckled. "Young lady, what you're lacking right now is a passionate and unforgettable love."

"With you?"

"I never said with me," Li Luo said, exasperated.

"Oh."

The two chatted for a few more sentences before the bell for class rang.

There were four classes this morning: Geography, English, Chinese, and Chemistry.

The Chinese teacher was their head teacher, Kong Junxiang.

The English teacher was Teacher Ding Xiang, who wore a floral dress and was very prettily dressed. She looked very young and spoke with a very pure British accent.

According to Zhang Guohuang's gossip, Teacher Ding had studied abroad in the UK before.

As for Geography and Chemistry, like Teacher Li who was now coming in for Math class, they were both male teachers, not worth mentioning.

However, compared to the young Geography teacher and the balding Chemistry teacher, Teacher Li looked quite normal. He was a standard middle-aged man, with some gray mixed into his neat, black short hair, and he wore a crisp casual shirt and slacks.

Teacher Li Maoxian was also the head teacher of Class Seven, but he had a deep impression of Li Luo, the monitor of Class Eight, and had even accepted drinks and small puddings from him twice.

Upon entering the classroom, Li Maoxian first introduced himself, then looked at Li Luo and said with a smile, "I need a math class representative. Li Luo, you're the class monitor, please help me recommend someone after class."

"Teacher Li." Li Luo raised his hand and thought for a moment. "Our classmate Lu Jiahao got a perfect score in math on the high school entrance exam."

"Then there's Shi Yanran, who scored 119."

"And also Ren Zheng and Fang Chen, who won first prize in the city-level math competition in middle school."

Li Luo had gleaned this information from the student roster in Kong Junxiang's office after getting familiar with him, which noted some students' special skills and awards.

But for Li Maoxian, this was somewhat surprising.

He raised his eyebrows and looked at the other students. "Of the four students just mentioned, is anyone willing to be the class representative?"

"Teacher, I'll do it." Lu Jiahao, whom Li Luo remembered was skilled in photography and liked small animals, raised his hand and said, "I was the math class representative in middle school."

"Alright, you're it then."

After the simple selection, Li Maoxian began the class.

After class, as he was about to leave, Li Maoxian said to Li Luo, "Teacher Kong wants you to go to his office after class. Don't forget."

"Oh, okay."

Li Luo acknowledged and followed Teacher Li upstairs to the office on the fifth floor to find Kong Junxiang.

Seeing him arrive, Kong Junxiang pulled out a poster and handed it to him, then said, "The first week of school is the club recruitment week."

"During the free time every evening, various clubs will set up stalls on Houde Road to recruit new members. This is the promotional poster."

"Post it on our class's blackboard and announce it to the students."

"After dinner these next few days, if they're interested in any clubs, they can go take a look on Houde Road."

Fuzhong No. 1 High School had four main asphalt roads on campus to facilitate the entry and exit of teachers' vehicles.

Among them, Houde Road, between the academic building and the sports field, was the road students walked on most often, with high foot traffic.

It was naturally a very normal practice for club recruitment to set up stalls here.

After some exploring during this period, Li Luo had also gained a general understanding of the club activities at Fuzhong No. 1 High School.

They currently had a total of seven classes in the morning and afternoon, each lasting forty minutes.

The last class in the evening would end at 4:40 PM, followed by a break until the preparatory bell for evening self-study rang at 6:30 PM.

At 6:40 PM, the first evening self-study session would officially begin.

In other words, including mealtime, the students of Fuzhong No. 1 High School had about two hours of free time every evening.

In addition, Fuzhong No. 1 High School also had a policy of only one day off on weekends.

That is, the break would start at noon on Saturday, and they had to return to school for evening self-study on Sunday evening.

Students who joined clubs would usually stay at school after classes ended on Saturday noon to participate in club activities in the afternoon.

This was the main activity time for the clubs at Fuzhong No. 1 High School.

Li Luo lowered his head and glanced at the club names listed on the poster.

Besides the Astronomy Club, Basketball Club, and Rock Club that Ying Chanxi had mentioned to him at the start of school, there were also the Math Club, English Club, Physics Club, and so on, corresponding to each academic subject.

According to Kong Junxiang, these clubs directly linked to subjects were actually established specifically for preparing for competitions.

Students who wanted to try their hand at various subject competitions in high school would generally join these clubs.

Then, after the last class ended at 4:40 PM every day, the student members of these clubs would gather in one or two classrooms, where a specialized competition teacher would arrange lessons...

And during the Saturday afternoon club activity time, the competition teachers would also arrange a weekly mini-test to ramp up the intensity.

If they performed exceptionally well, they would be selected by the competition teacher to join the competition class.

Hmm... a familiar feeling.

It was basically an eighth period and weekend tutoring in disguise.

In an atmosphere like that of Fuzhong No. 1 High School, most students who truly wanted to get ahead would sign up for a subject club they were interested in.

But Li Luo definitely wouldn't torture himself like that.

"Teacher Kong."

"Yes?"

"Didn't you say before that the class officers would be re-elected after the military training?" Li Luo held the poster, thinking that this was the kind of task Hua Xiuxiu should be doing, so he asked, "When do you plan to arrange that, teacher?"

"Oh, that." Kong Junxiang thought for a moment, then said, "Let's do it on Saturday morning. That'll give you all another week to get to know each other better."

"Okay." Li Luo sighed. It looked like he still had a few more days of work before he could be free.

Anyway, when the time came for the class monitor re-election, he just wouldn't go up on stage.

Then Hua Xiuxiu would definitely run, and that way, he could logically step down and enter a state of being carefree and unburdened.

(End of this chapter)
